text: {"claims": [{"id": "c2", "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "entails", "sub": "the kubelet executes the command"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P0.S1 states a 5-second probe period and P0.S3 shows the exec-style command probe, together giving the claim."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P1.S3", "rel": "entails", "sub": "HTTP GET request"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P1.S1 gives 3-second period; P1.S3 identifies the HTTP GET probe, so the HTTP example probes every 3 seconds."}, {"id": "c4", "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "refutes"}, {"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Exec period is 5s and HTTP period is 3s, so the exec example probes less often, not more often."}, {"id": "c12", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "entails"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "6 * 60", "op": ">", "value": "300"}, "reasoning": "P5.S0 caps startup at 5 minutes and P5.S2 kills the container after 300s if the startup probe never succeeds, so 6 minutes exceeds it."}, {"id": "c16", "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "10 / 3", "op": "==", "value": "5"}, "reasoning": "The probe period is 3 seconds (P1.S1); 10 seconds is about 3.33 times that period, not five times."}]}
